proof_body:
by
  intro x n a m hn hm
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hs : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i = n * m := by
    rw [hm]
    field_simp
  have h : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i - a) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i - m) ^ 2 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * (m - a) * x i + (a ^ 2 - m ^ 2)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hs]
  simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a m : ℝ), 0 < n → m = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i) / n → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i - a) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i - m) ^ 2 + n * (m - a) ^ 2
